title: Score32 local-reducer measured bounded recost for Llama7B
hypothesis: The current bounded score32 exact-reduction path still leaves the local 53/54-way persistent reducer unresolved and undercounts the full Llama7B layer by treating a per-group reducer bound as if it covered all 4 GQA8 groups. Consuming the merged August 4, 2026 r7 macro evidence plus the authoritative folded p53 reducer-only probe should replace that unresolved timing with revision-safe bounded schedules: an inherited single-clock full-layer bound and a separate CDC-requiring dual-clock component-rate bound, while keeping routed composed-top PPA and quality claims explicitly out of scope.

direct_comparison.primary_question: How does the bounded Llama7B score32 schedule change once the unresolved local-reducer timing is replaced by the measured folded p53 reducer service and the macro-composed top boundary evidence?
include: the preserved exact-reduction schedule recost artifact
the preserved folded-global bounded recost artifact
the merged August 4, 2026 pair-node and temporal-merge routed macro metrics

exclude: no NoC, SRAM, or 328-bit transport closure

required_evaluations.objective: Record a revision-safe bounded Llama7B score32 recost using measured local-reducer service plus merged r7 macro evidence.

expected_result.reason: Preserve the earlier score32 recost artifacts, validate the 52 pair + 1 temporal identity, replace the unresolved local-reducer timing with measured reducer-only service across all 4 GQA8 groups per layer, and keep any overlap or dual-clock schedule explicitly conditional.

required_evaluations.notes: Deterministic local audit only. Do not dispatch until the implementation merge exists. The report must keep the 10ns global-route OOM boundary and 15ns macro-placer assertion distinct, state explicitly that the 20730-cycle p53 probe excludes producer compute/service, correct the full-layer accounting to 4 GQA8 groups without double-counting the inherited 986-cycle producer window, and avoid any routed composed-top or quality-closure claim.

remaining_abstractions_after_this_step: The routed composed p53 top still has only boundary evidence and no feasible routed top PPA row.
The 16-cluster scaling remains arithmetic replication of per-cluster evidence, not a routed full-array composition.
Any overlap lower bound between producer service and reducer collection remains conditional until a real scheduler/handshake implementation is proven.
The dual-clock component-rate bound requires CDC and handshake closure and is not a measured full composition.
No quality delta, NoC, SRAM, or 328-bit transport closure is claimed by this recost.
